Mississippi State Senate
2025 Regular Session
YEAS AND NAYS. The yeas and nays being taken, the motion to recommit
S. B. No. 2515 failed by the following vote:

Yeas--Barnett, Blackmon, Blount, Brumfield, Bryan, Butler, Frazier, Hickman,
Horhn, Jackson, Norwood, Simmons D. T. (12th), Simmons S. (13th), Thomas, TurnerFord. Total--15.
Nays--Barrett, Berry, Blackwell, Boyd, Carter, Chassaniol, Chism, DeBar,
DeLano, England, Fillingane, Harkins, Hill, Hopson, Johnson, Kirby, Ladner, McCaughn,
McLendon, McMahan, Michel, Parker, Parks, Polk, Rhodes, Robinson, Seymour,
Suber, Tate, Thompson, Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--34.
Absent and those not voting----None.
Vacancies--1.
Senator Sparks, who would have voted nay on S. B. No. 2515, announced a pair
with Senator Jordan, who would have voted yea.
